units.locator: Article 28.3. Officials authorised to draw up administrative offence records
units.text: The list of officials entitled to draw up records of administrative offences whose consideration is assigned by this Code to the powers of executive authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation shall be established by authorised executive authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 28.3 · “The list of officials entitled to draw up records of…”

units.locator: Article 28.3. Officials authorised to draw up administrative offence records
units.text: The list of officials of departmental security bodies and organisations entitled to draw up administrative offence records in accordance with point 7 of part 5 of this Article shall be established, respectively, by federal executive authorities, the highest executive body of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation that is the federal city of Moscow, and organisations entitled to establish departmental security services.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 28.3 · “The list of officials of departmental security bodies and…”

units.locator: Article 28.3. Officials authorised to draw up administrative offence records
units.text: The list of officials of militarised and guard subdivisions of the organisation subordinate to the federal executive authority exercising functions in the sphere of activities of the National Guard Troops of the Russian Federation, entitled to draw up administrative offence records in accordance with point 7 of part 5 of this Article, shall be established by that federal executive authority.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 28.3 · “The list of officials of militarised and guard subdivisions of…”

units.locator: Article 28.3. Officials authorised to draw up administrative offence records
units.text: 5. Administrative offence records may be drawn up by:
units.label: Part 5 Art. 28.3

units.locator: Article 28.3. Officials authorised to draw up administrative offence records
units.text: 1) members of election commissions and referendum commissions with a decisive vote, authorised by election commissions or referendum commissions — concerning the administrative offences provided for by Articles 5.3 - 5.5, 5.8 - 5.10, 5.12, 5.15, 5.17 - 5.20, 5.47, 5.50, 5.51, 5.56 and 5.64 - 5.68 of this Code;
units.label: Point 1 Part 5 Art. 28.3

units.locator: Article 28.3. Officials authorised to draw up administrative offence records
units.text: 2) members of commissions for minors’ affairs and protection of their rights — concerning the administrative offences provided for by Articles 5.35 - 5.37, 6.10 and 6.23 of this Code;
units.label: Point 2 Part 5 Art. 28.3

units.locator: Article 28.3. Officials authorised to draw up administrative offence records
units.text: 3) inspectors of the Accounts Chamber of the Russian Federation, authorised officials of control and accounts bodies of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, and authorised officials of the control and accounts body of a federal territory — concerning the administrative offences provided for by Articles 5.21, 15.1 and 15.14 - 15.15.16, part 1 of Article 19.4, Article 19.4.1, part 20 of Article 19.5, and Articles 19.6 and 19.7 of this Code;
units.label: Point 3 Part 5 Art. 28.3

units.locator: Article 28.3. Officials authorised to draw up administrative offence records
units.text: 4) officials of state extra-budgetary funds — concerning the administrative offences provided for by Articles 15.3 and 15.4, part 1 of Article 15.6, part 1 of Article 15.7, Article 15.8 (as regards administrative offences connected with transferring contribution amounts to the relevant state extra-budgetary funds), part 2 of Article 15.10, parts 10.1 and 10.2 of Article 15.29, and Articles 15.32, 15.33 and 15.33.2 of this Code. The list of officials authorised to draw up administrative offence records in accordance with this point shall be approved by the heads of the state extra-budgetary funds;
units.label: Point 4 Part 5 Art. 28.3

units.locator: Article 28.3. Officials authorised to draw up administrative offence records
units.text: 5) officials of bodies and institutions of the penal enforcement system — concerning the administrative offences provided for by Article 9.19 (in relation to production facilities of the penal enforcement system), Articles 17.7 and 17.9, parts 1 and 6 of Article 19.3, part 1 of Article 19.5, Articles 19.6, 19.7 and 19.12, part 3 of Article 20.2.2, part 2 of Article 20.17, and part 1 of Article 20.25 of this Code;
units.label: Point 5 Part 5 Art. 28.3

units.locator: Article 28.3. Officials authorised to draw up administrative offence records
units.text: 6) officials of the state institution subordinate to the federal executive authority exercising functions for developing state policy and legal regulation in the production, processing and circulation of precious metals and precious stones — concerning the administrative offences provided for by Article 15.47, part 1 of Article 19.5, and Articles 19.6 and 19.7 of this Code;
units.label: Point 6 Part 5 Art. 28.3

units.locator: Article 28.3. Officials authorised to draw up administrative offence records
units.text: 7) officials of departmental security bodies and organisations and of militarised and guard subdivisions of the organisation subordinate to the federal executive authority exercising functions in the sphere of activities of the National Guard Troops of the Russian Federation — concerning the administrative offences provided for by Article 11.16 (as regards powers provided for by federal laws for control and supervision over fire safety in transport in relation to individuals), Article 11.20.1, part 3 of Article 20.2.2, and Articles 20.17 and 20.37 of this Code;
units.label: Point 7 Part 5 Art. 28.3

units.locator: Article 28.3. Officials authorised to draw up administrative offence records
units.text: 8) officials of state institutions exercising federal state forest supervision (forest protection) — concerning the administrative offences provided for by Article 7.1 (as regards forest plots within their powers under forest legislation), part 2 of Article 7.2 (as regards destruction of or damage to forest survey and forest management signs within their powers under forest legislation), Article 7.9, Article 7.10 (as regards unauthorised assignment of the right to use a forest plot or unauthorised exchange of a forest plot within their powers under forest legislation), Article 7.11 (within their powers under forest legislation), parts 3.1 - 3.4 of Article 8.2 (within their powers under forest legislation), Article 8.7 (within their powers under forest legislation), Article 8.8 (within their powers under forest legislation), Articles 8.25 - 8.28, 8.28.2 - 8.32 and 8.32.3, Article 8.45.1 (within their powers under forest legislation), part 1 of Article 19.4, part 1 of Article 19.5, and Articles 19.6 and 19.7 of this Code;
units.label: Point 8 Part 5 Art. 28.3

units.locator: Article 28.3. Officials authorised to draw up administrative offence records
units.text: 9) officials of state institutions exercising federal state fire supervision in forests — concerning the administrative offences provided for by Articles 8.32 and 8.32.3, part 1 of Article 19.4, part 1 of Article 19.5, and Articles 19.6 and 19.7 of this Code;
units.label: Point 9 Part 5 Art. 28.3

units.locator: Article 28.3. Officials authorised to draw up administrative offence records
units.text: 10) state inspectors in environmental protection in specially protected natural areas — concerning the administrative offences provided for by Article 8.39, part 1 of Article 19.4, part 1 of Article 19.5, and Articles 19.6 and 19.7 of this Code;
units.label: Point 10 Part 5 Art. 28.3

units.locator: Article 28.3. Officials authorised to draw up administrative offence records
units.text: 11) officials of the State Atomic Energy Corporation Rosatom — concerning the administrative offences provided for by:
units.label: Point 11 Part 5 Art. 28.3

units.locator: Article 28.3. Officials authorised to draw up administrative offence records
units.text: а) parts 2 - 4 of Article 14.1 of this Code (as regards entrepreneurial activity without a special permit (licence) to use nuclear materials and radioactive substances when carrying out work involving the use of atomic energy for defence purposes);
units.label: Subpoint «а» Point 11 Part 5 Art. 28.3

units.locator: Article 28.3. Officials authorised to draw up administrative offence records
units.text: б) Articles 6.3, 8.1, 9.4, 9.5 and 9.5.1, part 3 of Article 9.16, Article 14.44, part 1 of Article 19.4, Article 19.4.1, parts 6 and 15 of Article 19.5, Articles 19.6 and 19.7, part 1 of Article 19.26, Article 19.33, and parts 1, 2, 2.1, 6 and 6.1 of Article 20.4 of this Code (as regards the exercise of federal state construction supervision during construction and reconstruction of facilities of federal nuclear organisations);
units.label: Subpoint «б» Point 11 Part 5 Art. 28.3

units.locator: Article 28.3. Officials authorised to draw up administrative offence records
units.text: 12) officials of bodies and institutions specified in points 3 - 7 of part 1 and points 3 and 5 of part 2 of Article 22.1 of this Code that issued a ruling imposing an administrative fine, or authorised persons of collegial bodies specified in point 2 of part 1 and points 2 and 4 of part 2 of Article 22.1 of this Code that issued a ruling imposing an administrative fine — concerning the administrative offences provided for by part 1 of Article 20.25 of this Code, and, in administrative offence cases considered by judges, enforcement bailiffs;
units.label: Point 12 Part 5 Art. 28.3

units.locator: Article 28.3. Officials authorised to draw up administrative offence records
units.text: 13) masters of seagoing vessels, masters of inland navigation vessels and masters of mixed river-sea navigation vessels — concerning the administrative offences provided for by parts 2 and 5 of Article 11.17 of this Code;
units.label: Point 13 Part 5 Art. 28.3

units.locator: Article 28.3. Officials authorised to draw up administrative offence records
units.text: 14) officials of state institutions under the authority of executive authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation and exercising powers transferred to executive authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation for federal state supervision in the protection, reproduction and use of wildlife and its habitats — concerning the administrative offences provided for by part 2 of Article 7.2 (concerning destruction of or damage to signs installed by wildlife users or authorised state bodies for the protection, control and regulation of the use of wildlife and its habitats, and buildings and other structures belonging to those users and bodies, except for administrative offences committed within specially protected natural areas of federal significance), Article 7.11 (except for administrative offences committed within specially protected natural areas of federal significance), Article 8.33 (except for administrative offences committed within specially protected natural areas of federal significance), Article 8.34 (as regards administrative offences involving biological collections containing wildlife specimens, except for administrative offences committed within specially protected natural areas of federal significance), Article 8.35 (except for administrative offences committed within specially protected natural areas of federal significance), Article 8.36 (except for administrative offences committed within specially protected natural areas of federal significance), parts 1 - 1.3 of Article 8.37 (except for administrative offences committed within specially protected natural areas of federal significance), and part 3 of Article 8.37 (except for administrative offences committed within specially protected natural areas of federal significance) of this Code;
units.label: Point 14 Part 5 Art. 28.3

units.locator: Article 28.3. Officials authorised to draw up administrative offence records
units.text: 15) officials (state hunting inspectors) of state institutions under the authority of executive authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation exercising federal state supervision in the protection, reproduction and use of wildlife and its habitats — concerning the administrative offences provided for by point 14 of this part;
units.label: Point 15 Part 5 Art. 28.3

units.locator: Article 28.3. Officials authorised to draw up administrative offence records
units.text: 16) heads of fire and rescue subdivisions of the federal fire service established to organise fire prevention and firefighting and conduct emergency rescue operations in settlements (territorial subdivisions of the federal fire service), and fire and rescue subdivisions of the federal fire service established to organise fire prevention and firefighting and conduct emergency rescue operations in closed administrative-territorial entities and organisations of particular importance or subject to a restricted-access regime (special and military subdivisions of the federal fire service) — concerning the administrative offences provided for by Article 20.4 of this Code (where sufficient data indicating that an administrative offence has occurred are directly discovered during firefighting and emergency rescue operations within the boundaries of a fire and rescue garrison or an organisation in which fire prevention, firefighting and emergency rescue operations fall within the competence of a special or military subdivision of the federal fire service);
units.label: Point 16 Part 5 Art. 28.3

units.locator: Article 28.3. Officials authorised to draw up administrative offence records
units.text: 17) officials of the State Corporation for Space Activities Roscosmos — concerning the administrative offences provided for by parts 2 - 4 of Article 14.1 (as regards entrepreneurial activity without a special permit (licence) to conduct space activities) and part 30 of Article 19.5 of this Code;
units.label: Point 17 Part 5 Art. 28.3

units.locator: Article 28.3. Officials authorised to draw up administrative offence records
units.text: 18) officials of the management bodies and forces of the unified state system for prevention and elimination of emergencies — concerning the administrative offences provided for by Article 20.6.1 of this Code. The list of officials of those bodies, including officials of executive authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, shall be approved by the Government of the Russian Federation;
units.label: Point 18 Part 5 Art. 28.3

units.locator: Article 28.3. Officials authorised to draw up administrative offence records
units.text: 19) officials of federal executive authorities, their territorial bodies, executive authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation and military command bodies ensuring the martial law regime — concerning the administrative offences provided for by Article 20.5.1 of this Code.
units.label: Point 19 Part 5 Art. 28.3

units.locator: Article 28.3. Officials authorised to draw up administrative offence records
units.text: 6. Records of administrative offences provided for by laws of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, and records of administrative offences provided for by parts 3 and 4 of Article 14.1 and parts 2 and 3 of Article 19.20 in relation to types of activity licensed by executive authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, shall be drawn up by officials authorised by the respective constituent entities of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 28.3

units.locator: Article 28.3. Officials authorised to draw up administrative offence records
units.text: Records of administrative offences against public order and public safety provided for by laws of constituent entities of the Russian Federation shall be drawn up by officials of internal affairs bodies (police) where transfer of those powers is stipulated in agreements between the federal executive authority exercising functions for developing and implementing state policy and legal regulation in internal affairs and executive authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation on transferring the exercise of part of their powers.
units.label: Part 6 Art. 28.3 · “Records of administrative offences against public order and…”

units.locator: Article 28.3. Officials authorised to draw up administrative offence records
units.text: 6.1. Officials of executive authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, whose list is established by laws of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, may draw up records of the administrative offences provided for by part 1 of Article 19.4, Article 19.4.1, parts 1 and 20.1 of Article 19.5, and Article 19.7 of this Code when exercising regional state control (supervision), state financial control, and powers in federal state control (supervision) transferred to them.
units.label: Part 6.1 Art. 28.3

units.locator: Article 28.3. Officials authorised to draw up administrative offence records
units.text: 6.2. Repealed from 1 January 2018. — Federal Law of 31.12.2014 No. 514-ФЗ.
units.label: Part 6.2 Art. 28.3

units.locator: Article 28.3. Officials authorised to draw up administrative offence records
units.text: 6.3. Alongside the cases provided for by part 2 of this Article, officials of executive authorities of the respective constituent entities of the Russian Federation may draw up records of administrative offences provided for by this Code and committed in the territories of constituent entities of the Russian Federation where this is provided for by regulatory legal acts of the President of the Russian Federation or the Government of the Russian Federation on transferring powers of federal executive authorities for exercise by executive authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, adopted in accordance with federal laws, or by agreements concluded in accordance with federal law between federal executive authorities and executive authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation on transferring the exercise of part of their powers.
units.label: Part 6.3 Art. 28.3

units.locator: Article 28.3. Officials authorised to draw up administrative offence records
units.text: 6.4. In addition to the cases provided for by point 18 of part 5 of this Article, officials of executive authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation may draw up records of the administrative offences provided for by Article 20.6.1 of this Code. The list of those bodies and their officials shall be approved by the highest official (head of the highest executive state authority) of the constituent entity of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 6.4 Art. 28.3

units.locator: Article 28.3. Officials authorised to draw up administrative offence records
units.text: 6.5. In addition to the cases provided for by point 11 of part 2 of this Article, officials of executive authorities of constituent entities of the Russian Federation exercising control and supervision functions in the financial and budgetary sphere shall draw up records of the administrative offences provided for by parts 1 - 3 of Article 7.30.1 and parts 5 - 7 of Article 7.30.2 of this Code, on the basis of materials received from municipal financial control bodies containing data indicating that an administrative offence has occurred, in relation to procurement carried out for municipal needs.
units.label: Part 6.5 Art. 28.3

units.locator: Article 28.3. Officials authorised to draw up administrative offence records
units.text: 7. Officials of local self-government bodies, whose list is established by laws of constituent entities of the Russian Federation, and officials of public authorities of a federal territory, whose list is established by regulatory legal acts of the representative body of the federal territory, may draw up records of the administrative offences provided for by part 1 of Article 19.4, Article 19.4.1, parts 1, 31 and 32 of Article 19.5, and Article 19.7 of this Code when exercising municipal control; concerning the administrative offences provided for by Articles 5.21, 7.32.6, 15.1, 15.14 - 15.15.16 and 15.37.1, part 1 of Article 19.4, Article 19.4.1, parts 20 and 20.1 of Article 19.5, and Articles 19.6 and 19.7 of this Code when exercising municipal financial control; concerning the administrative offences provided for by parts 4 - 9 and 11 of Article 7.30.1 and parts 1 - 4, 8 and 9 of Article 7.30.2 of this Code when exercising procurement control; and concerning the administrative offences provided for by Article 15.49 of this Code when providing treasury support.
units.label: Part 7 Art. 28.3

units.locator: Article 28.4. Initiation of administrative offence cases by a prosecutor
units.text: Article 28.4. Initiation of administrative offence cases by a prosecutor
units.label: Art. 28.4

units.locator: Article 28.4. Initiation of administrative offence cases by a prosecutor
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 28.4. Initiation of administrative offence cases by a prosecutor
units.label: Art. 28.4

units.locator: Article 28.4. Initiation of administrative offence cases by a prosecutor
units.text: 1. Cases concerning the administrative offences provided for by Articles 5.1, 5.6, 5.7, 5.21, 5.23 - 5.25, 5.39, 5.45, 5.46, 5.48, 5.52, 5.58 - 5.63.2, 6.19, 6.20 and 7.24, part 10 of Article 7.30.1, Articles 7.35 and 8.32.2, part 2 of Article 8.49, Articles 12.35, 13.14 and 13.19.1, Article 13.19.3 (except for administrative offences committed by a developer or the developer’s officials), parts 7 and 8 of Article 13.19.5, parts 7 and 8 of Article 13.19.6, Articles 13.27 and 13.28, parts 1 - 4.1, 6 and 7 of Article 14.13 (except where those offences were committed by insolvency administrators), parts 1 and 2 of Article 14.25, part 6 of Article 14.28, parts 1 - 5 of Article 14.35, Article 14.56, part 1 of Article 15.10, part 4 of Article 15.27, Article 15.33.1, part 3 of Article 19.4, Articles 19.5.4 and 19.6.1, Article 19.8.1 (as regards administrative offences committed by officials of the federal executive authority in state tariff regulation), and Articles 19.9, 19.28, 19.29, 19.32, 19.34.2, 20.3.1, 20.3.2, 20.3.4, 20.26, 20.28 and 20.29 of this Code shall be initiated by a prosecutor. When supervising compliance with the Constitution of the Russian Federation and enforcement of laws in force in the territory of the Russian Federation, a prosecutor may also initiate a case concerning any other administrative offence for which liability is provided for by this Code or by a law of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 28.4

units.locator: Article 28.4. Initiation of administrative offence cases by a prosecutor
units.text: 2. A prosecutor shall issue a ruling initiating an administrative offence case, which shall contain the information provided for by Article 28.2 of this Code. That ruling shall be issued within the periods established by Article 28.5 of this Code.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 28.4

units.locator: Article 28.5. Time limits for drawing up an administrative offence record
units.text: Article 28.5. Time limits for drawing up an administrative offence record
units.label: Art. 28.5

units.locator: Article 28.5. Time limits for drawing up an administrative offence record
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 28.5. Time limits for drawing up an administrative offence record
units.label: Art. 28.5

units.locator: Article 28.5. Time limits for drawing up an administrative offence record
units.text: 1. An administrative offence record shall be drawn up immediately after the commission of an administrative offence is detected, except in the cases provided for by parts 2 and 3 of this Article, part 3.1 of Article 28.1 and part 1.4 of Article 28.2 of this Code.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 28.5

units.locator: Article 28.5. Time limits for drawing up an administrative offence record
units.text: 2. Where additional clarification of the circumstances of the case or of particulars of the individual or information about the legal entity against whom an administrative offence case is being initiated is required, the administrative offence record shall be drawn up within two days from the moment the administrative offence is detected.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 28.5

units.locator: Article 28.5. Time limits for drawing up an administrative offence record
units.text: 3. Where an administrative investigation is conducted, the administrative offence record shall be drawn up upon completion of the investigation within the periods provided for by Article 28.7 of this Code.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 28.5

units.locator: Article 28.6. Imposition of an administrative penalty without drawing up a record
units.text: Article 28.6. Imposition of an administrative penalty without drawing up a record
units.label: Art. 28.6

units.locator: Article 28.6. Imposition of an administrative penalty without drawing up a record
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 28.6. Imposition of an administrative penalty without drawing up a record
units.label: Art. 28.6

units.locator: Article 28.6. Imposition of an administrative penalty without drawing up a record
units.text: 1. Where an authorised official imposes an administrative penalty in the form of a warning or an administrative fine directly at the place where an individual committed an administrative offence, no administrative offence record shall be drawn up; instead, a ruling in the administrative offence case shall be issued in accordance with the procedure provided for by Article 29.10 of this Code. A copy of the ruling in the administrative offence case shall be handed against acknowledgement of receipt to the person in respect of whom it was issued and, upon request, to the victim. If receipt of a copy of the ruling is refused, it shall be sent to the person in respect of whom the ruling was issued by registered post or electronically, including in the form of an electronic document, in the manner and cases provided for by Article 24.9 of this Code, within three days from the day the ruling was issued.
units.label: Part 1 Art. 28.6

units.locator: Article 28.6. Imposition of an administrative penalty without drawing up a record
units.text: 1.1. Repealed. — Federal Law of 18.07.2011 No. 225-ФЗ.
units.label: Part 1.1 Art. 28.6

units.locator: Article 28.6. Imposition of an administrative penalty without drawing up a record
units.text: 1.2. Where administrative offences consisting in exceeding prices (tariffs) for goods and/or maximum levels of those prices (tariffs) established by regulatory legal acts of the Donetsk People’s Republic, the Lugansk People’s Republic, Zaporozhye Oblast or Kherson Oblast are detected in the territories of those constituent entities of the Russian Federation, an authorised official shall impose an administrative penalty in the form of a warning or an administrative fine on a citizen, official, individual entrepreneur or legal entity directly at the place where the administrative offence was committed; no administrative offence record shall be drawn up, and a ruling in the administrative offence case shall instead be issued in accordance with the procedure provided for by Article 29.10 of this Code.
units.label: Part 1.2 Art. 28.6

units.locator: Article 28.6. Imposition of an administrative penalty without drawing up a record
units.text: A copy of the ruling in the administrative offence case shall be handed against acknowledgement of receipt to the person in respect of whom it was issued and, upon request, to the victim. If receipt of a copy of the ruling is refused, it shall be sent to the person in respect of whom the ruling was issued by registered post or electronically, including in the form of an electronic document, in the manner and cases provided for by Article 24.9 of this Code, within three days from the day the ruling was issued.
units.label: Part 1.2 Art. 28.6 · “A copy of the ruling in the administrative offence case shall…”

units.locator: Article 28.6. Imposition of an administrative penalty without drawing up a record
units.text: Where the person against whom an administrative offence case has been initiated disputes that the administrative offence occurred and/or the administrative penalty imposed on that person, an administrative offence record shall be drawn up and attached to the ruling issued in accordance with this part.
units.label: Part 1.2 Art. 28.6 · “Where the person against whom an administrative offence case…”

units.locator: Article 28.6. Imposition of an administrative penalty without drawing up a record
units.text: 2. Where the person against whom an administrative offence case has been initiated disputes that the administrative offence occurred and/or the administrative penalty imposed on that person, an administrative offence record shall be drawn up and attached to the ruling issued in accordance with part 1 of this Article.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 28.6

units.locator: Article 28.6. Imposition of an administrative penalty without drawing up a record
units.text: 3. Where an administrative offence provided for by parts 3.1 - 3.4 of Article 8.2 or Chapter 12 of this Code, or an administrative offence in territorial improvement or an administrative offence consisting in non-compliance with the procedure for paying for vehicle travel on toll public roads of regional, intermunicipal or local significance, private public roads, toll sections of public roads of regional, intermunicipal or local significance or private public roads, provided for by a law of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation, committed using a vehicle or by the owner or other holder of a land plot or another immovable property and recorded by automatically operating special technical devices with photographic, motion-picture or video recording functions or by photographic, motion-picture or video recording equipment, is detected, or where data contained in a report or application by the owner (holder) of a vehicle that the vehicle was in the possession or use of another person when the administrative offence was recorded are confirmed in accordance with part 2 of Article 2.6.1 of this Code, no administrative offence record shall be drawn up; instead, a ruling in the administrative offence case shall be issued without the participation of the person against whom the administrative offence case has been initiated and drawn up in accordance with the procedure provided for by Article 29.10 of this Code. Copies of the ruling in the administrative offence case and of materials obtained using automatically operating special technical devices with photographic, motion-picture or video recording functions or photographic, motion-picture or video recording equipment shall be sent to the person against whom the administrative offence case has been initiated by registered post in the form of a paper copy of the ruling provided for by part 9 of Article 24.9 of this Code, or electronically, including in the form of an electronic document, in accordance with the procedure provided for by Article 24.9 of this Code, within three days from the day the ruling was issued.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 28.6

units.locator: Article 28.6. Imposition of an administrative penalty without drawing up a record
units.text: 3.1. Where an administrative offence provided for by part 6, 7 or 8 of Article 14.3.1, part 4, 5 or 6 of Article 14.6, part 4 of Article 14.43 or Article 15.12.2 of this Code and recorded using the monitoring information system is detected, no administrative offence record shall be drawn up; instead, a ruling in the administrative offence case shall be issued without the participation of the person against whom the administrative offence case has been initiated and drawn up in accordance with the procedure provided for by Article 29.10 of this Code. The ruling in such an administrative offence case shall be produced only in the form of an electronic document using the monitoring information system. Copies of the ruling in such an administrative offence case and of materials obtained using the monitoring information system shall be sent to the person against whom the administrative offence case has been initiated by registered post in the form of a paper copy of that ruling provided for by part 9 of Article 24.9 of this Code, or in the form of an electronic document in accordance with the procedure provided for by Article 24.9 of this Code, within three days from the day the ruling was issued.
units.label: Part 3.1 Art. 28.6

units.locator: Article 28.6. Imposition of an administrative penalty without drawing up a record
units.text: 4. Where the tax authorities’ automated information system checks reports and applications received from individuals and legal entities concerning data indicating that a person has committed actions (inaction) containing the constituent elements of an administrative offence for which administrative liability is provided for by parts 2, 4 and 6 of Article 14.5 of this Code, if that person has acknowledged that the alleged administrative offence occurred and, before a ruling in the administrative offence case is issued, voluntarily performed the duty for whose non-performance or improper performance the person is being held administratively liable, or where an administrative offence for which liability is provided for by part 2, 4 or 6 of Article 14.5 of this Code is committed by a person whose administrative penalty in the form of an administrative fine may be replaced with a warning in accordance with part 1 of Article 4.1.1 of this Code, no administrative offence record shall be drawn up; instead, a ruling in the administrative offence case shall be issued without that person’s participation and drawn up in accordance with the procedure provided for by Article 29.10 of this Code. A copy of the ruling in the administrative offence case shall be sent to that person by registered post in the form of a paper copy of the ruling provided for by part 9 of Article 24.9 of this Code, or in the form of an electronic document signed with an enhanced qualified electronic signature of an authorised official in accordance with the procedure established by the legislation of the Russian Federation, within three days from the day the ruling was issued.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 28.6

units.locator: Article 28.6. Imposition of an administrative penalty without drawing up a record
units.text: 5. Where the person specified in part 4 of this Article has not acknowledged that the alleged administrative offence occurred, an administrative offence record shall be drawn up and the administrative offence case shall be considered in accordance with the procedure provided for by Article 29.7 of this Code.
units.label: Part 5 Art. 28.6

units.locator: Article 28.7. Administrative investigation
units.text: Article 28.7. Administrative investigation
units.label: Art. 28.7

units.locator: Article 28.7. Administrative investigation
units.text: Code of Administrative Offences of the Russian Federation. Article 28.7. Administrative investigation
units.label: Art. 28.7

units.locator: Article 28.7. Administrative investigation
units.text: 1. An administrative investigation shall be conducted where, after detection of an administrative offence in the sphere of antimonopoly or patent legislation, legislation of the Russian Federation on communications (as regards the administrative offences provided for by Article 13.2.1, parts 2, 3, 5 and 6 of Article 13.29 and Article 13.29.4 of this Code), legislation on personal data (as regards the administrative offences provided for by parts 1 - 2.1 and 12 - 18 of Article 13.11 of this Code), legislation on ensuring the security of the critical information infrastructure of the Russian Federation (as regards the administrative offences provided for by Articles 13.12.1, 13.12.2 and 19.7.15 of this Code), legislation on mass media (as regards the administrative offences provided for units.label: Part 1 Art. 28.7

units.locator: Article 28.7. Administrative investigation
units.text: 2. The decision to initiate an administrative offence case and conduct an administrative investigation shall be taken by an official authorised under Article 28.3 of this Code to draw up an administrative offence record in the form of a procedural order, and by a prosecutor in the form of a ruling, immediately after the fact that an administrative offence has been committed is detected.
units.label: Part 2 Art. 28.7

units.locator: Article 28.7. Administrative investigation
units.text: 3. The procedural order initiating an administrative offence case and conducting an administrative investigation shall specify the date and place of its drawing up, the position, surname and initials of the person who drew it up, the reason for initiating the administrative offence case, data indicating that an administrative offence has occurred, and the Article of this Code or of a law of a constituent entity of the Russian Federation providing for administrative liability for that administrative offence. When a procedural order initiating an administrative offence case and conducting an administrative investigation is issued, the individual or legal representative of the legal entity in respect of whom it is issued, and other participants in the administrative offence proceedings, shall have their rights and duties under this Code explained to them, and an entry to that effect shall be made in the procedural order.
units.label: Part 3 Art. 28.7

units.locator: Article 28.7. Administrative investigation
units.text: 3.1. A copy of the procedural order initiating an administrative offence case and conducting an administrative investigation shall, within twenty-four hours, be handed against acknowledgement of receipt or sent to the individual or legal representative of the legal entity in respect of whom it is issued, and to the victim.
units.label: Part 3.1 Art. 28.7

units.locator: Article 28.7. Administrative investigation
units.text: 4. An administrative investigation shall be conducted at the place where the administrative offence was committed or detected. An administrative investigation in an administrative offence case initiated by an official authorised to draw up administrative offence records shall be conducted by that official or, by decision of the head of the body handling the administrative offence case or the head’s deputy, by another official of that body authorised to draw up administrative offence records.
units.label: Part 4 Art. 28.7

units.locator: Article 28.7. Administrative investigation
units.text: 5. The period for conducting an administrative investigation may not exceed one month from the moment an administrative offence case is initiated. In exceptional cases, upon a written motion by the official handling the case, that period may be extended:
units.label: Part 5 Art. 28.7

units.locator: Article 28.7. Administrative investigation
units.text: 1) by decision of the head of the body handling the administrative offence case or the head’s deputy — by no more than one month;
units.label: Point 1 Part 5 Art. 28.7

units.locator: Article 28.7. Administrative investigation
units.text: 2) by decision of the head of the higher customs authority or the head’s deputy, or by decision of the head of the federal executive authority authorised in customs affairs that is handling the administrative offence case or the head’s deputy — for a period of up to six months;
units.label: Point 2 Part 5 Art. 28.7
